scripts.serve: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --only functions
scripts.deploy: npm run build && firebase deploy --only functions
scripts.secrets:set: firebase functions:secrets:set STRIPE_SECRET_KEY && firebase functions:secrets:set STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET && firebase functions:secrets:set STRIPE_PRICE_ID
scripts.secrets:check: firebase functions:secrets:access STRIPE_SECRET_KEY && firebase functions:secrets:access STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET && firebase functions:secrets:access STRIPE_PRICE_ID
